facts.fact: The NPA had 37 cybercrime cases on court rolls involving 88 charges under the Cyber Crimes Act of 2020, per the Justice Minister's reply.
The NPA had 37 cases on court rolls nationally with 88 charges under the Cyber Crimes Act of 2020, per a parliamentary reply of 29 November 2024.
Police Minister Mchunu told Parliament 2,679 cybercrime cases were reported in 2022/23 and 2023/24, with 33 and 50 NPA referrals in the two years.
